description: Search German federal statutes and ordinances (Gesetze im Internet, BMJ/juris) BY TITLE OR ABBREVIATION — "BGB", "StGB", "Datenschutz", "Straßenverkehr". An exact or near abbreviation match (BGB, StGB, HGB, BDSG, GG…) returns that one law directly; otherwise ranks law titles by word overlap. Returns each match's abbreviation and official title. Use for "what is the abbreviation for the German Civil Code" or "find the German data protection act". Keyless.

limit.description: Max results, default 10, max 25 (ignored on an exact abbreviation match).
